1	/**
2	 * Replay-safe, model-free tool-result pruning service.
3	 *
4	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner
5	 */
6	
7	import { Context, Service } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
8	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
9	import { freezeMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
10	import type { ContentBlock } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
11	import type { Session, SessionEvent, ToolResultMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
12	// Type-only: the `compaction/*` SessionEventMap merges (the shadow-price event).
13	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction'
14	// Type-only: the `ctx.tokenMeter` Context merge for the declared injection.
15	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter'
16	import { codePointLength, DEFAULTS, PRUNE_MARKER, resolveConfig } from './config.ts'
17	import type {
18	  PrunedEntry,
19	  PruneResult,
20	  ResolvedConfig,
21	  ToolResultPruneConfig,
22	} from './types.ts'
23	
24	export { codePointLength, DEFAULTS, PRUNE_MARKER, resolveConfig } from './config.ts'
25	export type {
26	  PrunedEntry,
27	  PruneResult,
28	  ResolvedConfig,
29	  ToolResultPruneConfig,
30	} from './types.ts'
31	
32	declare module '@deepseek-ai/cordis' {
33	  interface Context {
34	    toolResultPruner: ToolResultPruner
35	  }
36	}
37	
38	interface SnapshotCandidate {
39	  readonly seq: number
40	  readonly event: SessionEvent<'tool/result'>
41	}
42	
43	/** Deterministic head/middle/tail pruning for current tool-result surface nodes. */
44	export class ToolResultPruner extends Service {
45	  // The token meter prices each shadowed node for its logged shadow-price
46	  // event, so pruning genuinely requires the pricing capability.
47	  static inject = ['tokenMeter']
48	
49	  static Config: z<ToolResultPruneConfig> = z.object({
50	    thresholdChars: z.number().step(1).min(1).default(DEFAULTS.thresholdChars),
51	    headChars: z.number().step(1).min(0).default(DEFAULTS.headChars),
52	    tailChars: z.number().step(1).min(0).default(DEFAULTS.tailChars),
53	  })
54	
55	  /** Resolved and immutable character budgets. */
56	  readonly config: ResolvedConfig
57	
58	  constructor(ctx: Context, config: ToolResultPruneConfig = {}) {
59	    super(ctx, 'toolResultPruner')
60	    this.config = resolveConfig(config)
61	  }
62	
63	  /**
64	   * Measure text content in Unicode code points; non-text blocks cost zero.
65	   * @param blocks - tool-result content to measure.
66	   * @returns total Unicode code points across text blocks.
67	   */
68	  measureContent(blocks: readonly ContentBlock[]): number {
69	    let chars = 0
70	    for (const block of blocks) {
71	      if (block.type === 'text') chars += codePointLength(block.text)
72	    }
73	    return chars
74	  }
75	
76	  /**
77	   * Replace an over-budget text middle while retaining rich-block order.
78	   * Text slicing is by Unicode code point, not UTF-16 code unit, so a retained
79	   * boundary cannot split a surrogate pair. Grapheme clusters may still split.
80	   * @param blocks - original tool-result content.
81	   * @returns pruned content, or `null` when the text is within budget.
82	   */
83	  pruneContent(blocks: readonly ContentBlock[]): ContentBlock[] | null {
84	    const totalChars = this.measureContent(blocks)
85	    if (totalChars <= this.config.thresholdChars) return null
86	
87	    const removedStart = this.config.headChars
88	    const removedEnd = totalChars - this.config.tailChars
89	    const pruned: ContentBlock[] = []
90	    let consumed = 0
91	    let markerInserted = false
92	
93	    for (const block of blocks) {
94	      if (block.type !== 'text') {
95	        pruned.push(block)
96	        continue
97	      }
98	
99	      const points = Array.from(block.text)
100	      const blockStart = consumed
101	      const blockEnd = blockStart + points.length
102	      const headEnd = Math.min(points.length, Math.max(0, removedStart - blockStart))
103	      const tailStart = Math.min(points.length, Math.max(0, removedEnd - blockStart))
104	      const intersectsRemoved = blockStart < removedEnd && blockEnd > removedStart
105	      const marker = intersectsRemoved && !markerInserted ? PRUNE_MARKER : ''
106	      if (marker.length > 0) markerInserted = true
107	      const text = points.slice(0, headEnd).join('')
108	        + marker
109	        + points.slice(tailStart).join('')
110	      if (text.length > 0) pruned.push({ ...block, text })
111	      consumed = blockEnd
112	    }
113	
114	    /* v8 ignore next -- totalChars > threshold and valid budgets guarantee a removed text span. */
115	    if (!markerInserted) throw new Error('tool-result prune: failed to locate the removed text span')
116	    const charsAfter = this.measureContent(pruned)
117	    /* v8 ignore next -- config validation fixes the emitted head + marker + tail budget. */
118	    if (charsAfter > this.config.thresholdChars || charsAfter >= totalChars) {
119	      throw new Error('tool-result prune: replacement must be smaller and within threshold')
120	    }
121	    return pruned
122	  }
123	
124	  /**
125	   * Prune every over-budget tool result from one stable current-surface snapshot.
126	   * Each replacement preserves the complete event data except for `content`,
127	   * cites the shadowed node so replay can recover the replacement input, and is
128	   * immediately preceded by a `compaction/prune` shadow-price event pricing the
129	   * shadowed node through the injected token meter, so pure consumers can
130	   * subtract it without per-node state.
131	   * @param session - session whose current surface is rewritten.
132	   * @returns landed replacements and aggregate Unicode-code-point savings.
133	   * @throws when the session rejects a replacement; replacements committed
134	   * earlier in the pass remain durable.
135	   */
136	  pruneSession(session: Session): PruneResult {
137	    const candidates: SnapshotCandidate[] = []
138	    for (const seq of [...session.surface.nodes]) {
139	      const event = session.events[seq]
140	      /* v8 ignore next -- surface seqs are validated contiguous log references. */
141	      if (event?.type === 'tool/result') candidates.push({ seq, event })
142	    }
143	
144	    const pruned: PrunedEntry[] = []
145	    let charsRemoved = 0
146	    for (const { seq, event } of candidates) {
147	      const result = event.data.message.content[0]
148	      const content = this.pruneContent(result.content)
149	      if (content === null) continue
150	      const charsBefore = this.measureContent(result.content)
151	      const charsAfter = this.measureContent(content)
152	      const message = freezeMessage<ToolResultMessage>({
153	        ...event.data.message,
154	        content: [{
155	          ...result,
156	          content,
157	        }] as [typeof result],
158	      })
159	      // Shadow-price protocol: the metering event and its replacement are
160	      // appended synchronously adjacent, so pure consumers subtract the
161	      // shadowed node's heuristic price without retaining per-node state.
162	      session.append('compaction/prune', {
163	        shadowedRange: { start: seq, end: seq },
164	        shadowedSeqs: [seq],
165	        shadowedTokenCount: this.ctx.tokenMeter.estimateMessage(event.data.message),
166	      })
167	      const replacement = session.append('tool/result', {
168	        ...event.data,
169	        message,
170	      }, {
171	        surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', start: seq, end: seq },
172	        sourceEventSeqs: [seq],
173	      })
174	      pruned.push({
175	        originalSeq: seq,
176	        replacementSeq: replacement.seq,
177	        callId: event.data.message.source.callId,
178	        charsBefore,
179	        charsAfter,
180	      })
181	      charsRemoved += charsBefore - charsAfter
182	    }
183	    return { pruned, charsRemoved }
184	  }
185	}
186	
187	export default ToolResultPruner
188
